messages:
sam: FYI: we had a replay for apac-prod (2026-03-19T03) fail with 429 when promoted from staged->run. Console shows 'quota check failed' but no suggested mitigation. Can someone triage?
juhi: Can you drop the replay id? I want to see if it hit tenant slot cap or global concurrency.
sam: id=RPL-20260319-apac-9f. svc-replay logs: "quota_check: tenant_limit_exceeded route=economy".
mike: Economy route still uses slot_weight=1.0 by default; we introduced slot scaling in the API but console hasn't wired the slider.
anne: This is symptomatic of the same UI/API mismatch we've seen. We should either: a) map console slider to slot_weight at the API layer, or b) have the API accept slotUnits alias for backward-compat.
ops-bot: replay-service: RPL-20260319-apac-9f -> 429 QuotaExceeded (tenant=beta-corp, est_tokens=340k)
juhi: 340k tokens is small enough that routing to priority-low (same perf, smaller kv) might succeed and finish faster. But we need to surface estimated token burn for each route in the console preflight.
sam: Agreed. Right now console only shows cost estimate for the default route. We should show a per-route diff.
mike: API sketch: POST /replays/preflight { tenant, from, to, routes: ["default","economy","priority-low"] } -> returns [{route, est_tokens, slot_weight, kv_warm_needed}]. That way console can render choices and a one-click reroute.
anne: Love the preflight idea. We also need a safeguard: if preflight shows route with kv_warm_needed=true, present a checkbox to trigger a pre-warm step (adds ~30s but avoids inflated token usage from retries).
juhi: UX concern: don't make operators click 3 times. Show recommended route + reason (quota/latency/cost) and a single action: "apply recommended route" with an advanced dropdown.
dashboard-team: Can we add a dashboard panel that surfaces "replay_preflight_failures" per-tenant so SRE can see recurring misses?
mike: Also note: some tenants have negotiated burst allowances. API should accept an optional header X-Tenant-Burst:true for ops to attempt a short-lived override (audit-logged).
sam: For immediate mitigation on RPL-20260319-apac-9f, can ops try CLI: `redwood replay run --id RPL-20260319-apac-9f --route priority-low --slot-weight 0.6`?
juhi: I'll run it if you want. But beware of kv: priority-low may not have warmed shards in apac.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: oncall_replay started a run at 2026-03-19T03:22Z
ops-bot: svc-replay: RPL-20260319-apac-9f rerun -> queued (route=priority-low, slot_weight=0.6)
mike: If priority-low finishes but latency spikes >7s, we'll need to abort and try slot bump. Add an alert: replay:latency>7s for replays older than 6h.
juhi: typo nudge: that's me (juhi).
anne: For longer-term changes, propose a small API shim (replay-proxy) that adds: preflight endpoint, slotUnits->slot_weight translation, and automatic fallback attempt to economy route once if default fails. Create ticket API-8891.
mike: One more gotcha: billing tags. If we reroute to priority-low, cost attribution should remain to original tenant and not to the priority service account. Audit logs must include original_tenant and route_override.
juhi: I'll open dashboards ticket DASH-311 to add the preflight failure panel and a short histogram of reroute success rate.
sam: Thanks. For RPL-20260319-apac-9f: rerun is in flight, monitoring /dashboards/telemetry/recompute -> watch "recompute-cost" and "replay-success-rate". I'll update in 10m.
ops-bot: oncall_replay marked thread resolved at 2026-03-19T03:55Z
